talk.jaymospowers.demon_master.chapel_gr: "You put out your own lamp long before you came in here. Good. Ask, then. It will cost you blood. It always does."
"You've bled enough today. I will hear you when the sky has turned."
message.jaymospowers.chapel.pull: Somewhere to the %s a lamp has gone out, and something under it knows your name.
